title: Robust neuronal differentiation of human embryonic stem cells for neurotoxicology
author: Samara, Falck, et al.
materials: Countess II FL Automated Cell Counter

Timing: 1.5 h, including coating of culture dishes
1.Ensure that you have enough hESC cells in culture, growing at a maximum confluency of 80%–90% before seeding.2.Prepare Stage I neural induction medium (NIM). See manufacturer’s instructions for N2 supplement: if N2 is aliquoted, and the penicillin/streptomycin solution thawed, the required time is 10 min.3.Precoat culture dishes with Geltrex for stage I of the protocol. See also recipes for preparation of stock solutions.

steps.title: Prepare reagent stocks and solutions
steps.instruction: Make all required stock solutions and thaw supplements as described, keeping all concentrations, volumes, and storage conditions.

substeps.instruction: SB431542: dissolve 5 mg in 650 µL DMSO (20 mM stock); aliquot (e.g., 10 µL) and store at –20 °C; use 0.5 µL per mL medium for 10 µM final (1:2000).

LDN‑193189: dissolve 10 mg in 22.6 mL DMSO (1 mM stock); warm to 37 °C, vortex until clear; aliquot (e.g., 2 µL) and store at –20 °C; dilute 1:10 in ddH₂O for 1 µM working stock; add 0.1 µL per mL medium for 100 nM final (1:10 000).
XAV939: dissolve 10 mg in 1.6 mL DMSO (20 mM stock); aliquot and store at –20 °C; dilute 1:10 in ddH₂O for 2 mM working stock; add 0.1 µL per mL medium for 2 µM final (1:10 000).
Y‑27632 (ROCKi): dilute to 10 mM in ddH₂O; aliquot and store at –20 °C; add 1 µL per mL medium for 10 µM final (1:1000).

Recombinant human bFGF: reconstitute powder in 1× PBS + 0.1 % BSA to 10 µg/mL; aliquot (e.g., 25 µL per 25 mL medium) and store at 4 °C (1 week) or –20 °C/–80 °C (long‑term); add 1 µL per mL medium for 10 ng/mL final.

Recombinant human EGF: dissolve 1 000 µg in 10 mL 1× PBS + 0.1 % BSA (100 µg/mL stock); aliquot (e.g., 100 µL) and store at –20 °C; make 1:1000 working solution (0.1 µg/mL) and add 1 µL per mL medium for 10 ng/mL final.
Poly‑L‑ornithine: dissolve powder in water to 10 mg/mL; dilute to 0.1 mg/mL with ddH₂O; further dilute 1:500 to obtain 20 µg/mL (PO) stock; store at 4 °C (weeks) or –20 °C (long‑term).

Geltrex: thaw overnight at 4 °C; keep on ice; prepare working solution by adding 250 µL Geltrex stock to 24.75 mL Knockout DMEM (25 mL total); aliquot 250 µL into 0.5 mL tubes; for coating dilute 1:100 in serum‑free media; store coated plates at 4 °C ≤2 weeks, sealed with parafilm.
Fibronectin: dissolve vial contents in water; warm to 37 °C and dilute to 1 mg/mL; store as 1:1000 stock at –20 °C; avoid agitation.
N2 and B‑27 supplements: thaw and aliquot according to manufacturer’s instructions.

steps.title: Prepare Stage I neural induction medium
steps.instruction: Prepare NIM by mixing basal medium with N2, B‑27, penicillin/streptomycin (if thawed) and add LSX inhibitors freshly before each change.

substeps.instruction: Add SB431542 to a final 10 µM (0.5 µL per mL).
Add LDN‑193189 to a final 100 nM (0.1 µL per mL).
Add XAV939 to a final 2 µM (0.1 µL per mL).
Warm NIM to 37 °C before use.

steps.title: Coat plates for Stage I
steps.instruction: Coat each well of a 12‑well plate with Geltrex for neural induction.

substeps.instruction: Add 0.5 mL diluted Geltrex (1:100) to each well.
Incubate plate at 37 °C for 1 h.
Remove Geltrex solution immediately before seeding cells.

steps.title: Day 0 – Detach and seed hESCs
steps.instruction: Detach undifferentiated hESCs, count, and plate at 17 K cells / cm² on Geltrex‑coated wells.

substeps.instruction: Aspirate spent medium and wash cells twice with 1 mL pre‑warmed 1× PBS per well.
Add 1 mL pre‑warmed Accutase per well; incubate 7 min at 37 °C (extend to 9 min if needed).
Collect cell suspension with a 5 mL serological pipette; transfer to a 15 mL tube containing 4 mL Essential 8 medium + 10 µM ROCKi.
Set aside 20 µL for counting.
Centrifuge 300 × g for 4 min; discard supernatant and resuspend pellet in 10 mL E8 + ROCKi.
Count cells and assess viability (≥85 %) using Countess II or haemocytometer.
Remove Geltrex from coated wells (if still present).
Plate cells at 17 K cells / cm² (≈0.2 mL cell suspension per well for 12‑well format) and spread evenly.
Incubate at 37 °C, 5 % CO₂.

steps.title: Day 1 – Initiate neural induction
steps.instruction: Replace E8 + ROCKi with NIM containing LSX inhibitors to start differentiation.

substeps.instruction: Aspirate 1 mL medium from each well.
Add 1 mL pre‑warmed NIM with freshly added LSX inhibitors.
From Day 1 to Day 6, change NIM (with LSX) daily; keep plates at 37 °C, 5 % CO₂.

steps.title: Prepare Stage II coating and medium
steps.instruction: Coat new 12‑well plates with poly‑ornithine/fibronectin (POF) followed by Geltrex and prepare neuronal self‑patterning medium (NSP).

substeps.instruction: Make POF mix: dilute PO stock 1:500 in ddH₂O to 20 µg/mL; add 50 µL fibronectin stock (1 mg/mL) per 50 mL to obtain 1 µg/mL fibronectin.
Add 0.5 mL POF mix to each well; incubate 2 h at 37 °C.
Wash wells gently with 1 mL 1× PBS and aspirate.
Add 0.5 mL diluted Geltrex (1:100) to each well; incubate 1 h at 37 °C.
Plates can be stored at 4 °C ≤2 weeks, sealed with parafilm.
Prepare NSP medium by adding N2, B‑27, penicillin/streptomycin (if thawed) to basal medium; warm to 37 °C.

steps.title: Day 7 – Passage to Stage II
steps.instruction: Detach cells, count, and re‑plate on POF‑Geltrex‑coated wells at 130 K cells / cm².

substeps.instruction: Aspirate medium and add 1 mL pre‑warmed Accutase per well; incubate 7 min at 37 °C (extend to 9 min if needed).
Collect cells with a serological pipette (10 mL, 5 mL or 1 mL) into 15 mL tubes containing NSP medium + 10 µM ROCKi.
Set aside 20 µL for counting.
Centrifuge 300 × g for 4 min; discard supernatant and resuspend pellet in NSP + ROCKi.
Count cells and verify viability (≥90 %).
Remove Geltrex from POF‑Geltrex‑coated wells.
Plate cells at 130 K cells / cm² (≈0.5 mL cell suspension per well for 12‑well format) and spread evenly.
Incubate at 37 °C, 5 % CO₂.
Change NSP medium daily from Day 8 to Day 12; ROCKi is only used at this passage.

steps.title: Prepare Stage III coating and medium
steps.instruction: Coat new plates with a higher volume of POF followed by Geltrex and prepare neuronal maturation medium (NMM).

substeps.instruction: Prepare POF mix as before (20 µg/mL PO, 1 µg/mL fibronectin).
Add 5 mL POF mix to each well of a 12‑well plate; incubate 2 h at 37 °C.
Wash wells with 1 mL 1× PBS and aspirate.
Add 0.5 mL diluted Geltrex; incubate 1 h at 37 °C.
Plates may be stored at 4 °C ≤2 weeks, sealed.
Prepare NMM by adding N2, B‑27, penicillin/streptomycin (if thawed) to basal medium; warm to 37 °C.

steps.title: Day 13 – Passage to Stage III
steps.instruction: Detach cells, count, and plate on POF‑Geltrex‑coated wells at 130 K cells / cm² for maturation.

substeps.instruction: Aspirate medium and add 1 mL pre‑warmed Accutase per well; incubate 7 min at 37 °C (extend to 9 min if needed).
Collect cells with serological pipettes into 15 mL tubes containing NMM + 10 µM ROCKi.
Set aside 20 µL for counting.
Centrifuge 300 × g for 4 min; discard supernatant and resuspend pellet in NMM + ROCKi.
Count cells; ensure viability >85 %.
Remove Geltrex from POF‑Geltrex‑coated wells.
Plate cells at 130 K cells / cm² and spread evenly.
Incubate at 37 °C, 5 % CO₂.
Change NMM daily from Day 14 to Day 19; ROCKi is only used at this passage.

steps.title: Perform daily media changes
steps.instruction: Replace culture medium each day without washing steps.

substeps.instruction: Stage I (Day 1‑6): replace NIM + LSX inhibitors daily.
Stage II (Day 8‑12): replace NSP medium daily.
Stage III (Day 14‑19): replace NMM daily.

steps.title: Immunofluorescence staining of cultures
steps.instruction: Fix and stain cells on 13 mm glass coverslips for marker analysis.

substeps.instruction: Wash coverslips once with 1× PBS.
Fix in 4 % paraformaldehyde for 15 min at room temperature.
Wash 3 × 10 min with 1× PBS.
Permeabilize with 0.3 % Triton X‑100 in PBS for 15 min; wash 3 × 1 min PBS.
Block with 10 % horse serum for 30 min.
Incubate with primary anti‑FOXG1 antibody (1:1000 in PBS + 0.03 % Triton) overnight at 4 °C (12‑16 h).
Next day, equilibrate 2 h at room temperature; wash 3 × 15 min PBS.
Incubate with secondary antibody (1:500 in PBS + 0.03 % Triton) 1 h at room temperature.
Wash 3 × 15 min PBS.
Mount coverslips with ProLong™ Gold Antifade Mountant containing DAPI according to manufacturer’s instructions.

steps.title: qRT‑PCR analysis of gene expression
steps.instruction: Extract RNA, synthesize cDNA, and quantify target genes by TaqMan qPCR.

substeps.instruction: Extract total RNA using the Qiagen or Nordic Biosite kit as per the supplier’s protocol.
Perform reverse transcription with the QuantiTect Reverse Transcription Kit (Qiagen) following the kit instructions.
Set up qPCR reactions with TaqMan Gene Expression Master Mix and the appropriate TaqMan assays (RPL30, RAF1 for normalization; other markers as needed).
Cycling conditions: 50 °C 2 min (UNG); 95 °C 10 min (polymerase activation); 40 cycles of 95 °C 15 s (denaturation) and 60 °C 1 min (annealing/extension); hold at 4 °C.
Analyze Ct values with the ddCt package v1.40.0 in R 4.0.4; visualize with tidyverse.
Perform statistical comparisons using t‑test in the ggpubr package v0.4.0.

description: The neuronal differentiation protocol below describes the specific steps for using the hESC cell line HS360 (Ström et al., 2010; Main et al., 2020), and this has been replicated using H9 hESCs (Thomson et al., 1998) under the same conditions. hESCs should be maintained under pluripotency conditions before neural differentiation, and protocols for hESC maintenance are standardized (Desai et al., 2015). The protocol consists of three major stages: neural induction, self-patterning and neuronal maturation. Cell counts are standardized at Day 0 seeding and the culture medium is changed daily. The cell cultures are split and reseeded at standardized cell numbers in differently coated culture dishes at Day 7 and Day 13, and the protocol ends at Day 20. The preferred cell culture format is 12-well culture dishes. We provide detailed recipes for the preparation of the stock and working solutions, and for the composition of the media used at all stages in materials and equipment. The recommended volumes for the coating of the culture plates, cell detachment and washing, along with cell culture media volumes and cell seeding counts are provided in Table 1.
